description: Edit a category's name, slug, or hub-page SEO/body copy (seoTitle, metaDescription, intro, noindex). WARNING: changing `slug` changes the category hub's public URL (<blogPath>/category/<slug>) — there is NO redirect, so the old URL 404s the moment this call lands. Changing `name` alone never touches `slug`.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

intro.description: Long-form hub body copy rendered under the H1, taking precedence over the category's `description`.

metaDescription.description: Overrides the hub page's generated meta description when set and non-empty.

noindex.description: Set true to serve the hub page with robots noindex.

seoTitle.description: Overrides the hub page's generated <title> when set and non-empty.

slug.description: New URL slug. Re-normalized server-side; rejected with an error if another category in the same publication already uses it. Changing this changes the public hub URL with no redirect.

name: update_blog_category
